Hi Alicia —

Great talking yesterday. Per our discussion, I pulled together a concise Joint Success Slate (our lightweight MAP) that maps milestones, owners, success criteria, and a proposed close timeline. The goal is to give both teams a single source of truth for the pilot and decision milestone.

What I attached/linked:
- Initial MAP PDF (redwood_map_template_v1.pdf) — same content as the GDoc if you want to co-edit.
- Acceptance criteria matrix (xlsx) — technical & business gates we typically use for pilots.
- Live doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Jk-example-MAP-template (edit access granted to you)

Suggested 8-week pilot cadence (flexible):
1) Week 0: kickoff + data access setup (owners: Aptiva Eng / Redwood Onboarding)
2) Week 1–2: integration & sample runs (success: sample inference w/ latency < 300ms p95)
3) Week 3–5: feature validation + quality review (success: NPS >= 7 on internal eval set)
4) Week 6: business review + exec demo (stakeholder alignment)
5) Week 7–8: final acceptance & contracting for Dedicated capacity

Ask: please review the doc and the acceptance criteria, flag anything you want to move earlier/later, and add owners where it makes sense. If agreeable, we can convert this to a shared Slides view for the exec review.

I'll follow up with Marissa and Rishi on an initial runbook for infra access.

Best,
Jonas
